name: OneThing API
description:
OneThing turns a photo, a link or a picked product into a live one-product shop that takes
PayPal payments, or a recommendation page that earns referral commissions through Channel3.

**How a shop is made**
1. `createShop`: start from a photo, a link, or a Channel3 product. Gemini guesses what it
   is, how it's delivered, the price, a short link and the page design. You get back the
   shop's link name and an **admin token**.
2. `updateShop`: correct anything the AI guessed, then set `status: live`.
3. Buyers pay on `https://<host>/<slug>` with PayPal. Sellers read orders and ship them.

**Auth.** Seller endpoints take the shop's admin token in the `x-admin-token` header. Buyer
endpoints (checkout, access-code verification, downloads) are public.

**Access codes.** A digital product can unlock an app or game instead of shipping a file.
Each paid order gets a code such as `K7QF-M2XP-9HTD`; your app calls `verifyAccessCode`
before unlocking. Raptor Rush on miriogames.com is a live example.

All money moves through PayPal (sandbox in this deployment). OneThing never holds card data.

folders.name: Accounts
folders.description: Sign in as a seller with an email or a phone number. Shops made while signed in belong to the account.

folders.name: Shops
folders.description: Create a shop and manage it as its seller.

folders.name: Access codes
folders.description: Unlock a paid app or game with a buyer's code.

folders.name: Orders
folders.description: The seller's orders, fulfilment and PayPal webhook log.

requests.name: signIn
requests.description: Signs in with an email address or a phone number, creating the account the first time. There's no password and no verification (sandbox). The response sets the `ot_session` cookie; shops created with it belong to the account and are listed on `/account`. Signing in with an email also claims older shops whose seller email matches. In a browser, sellers can instead use Log in with PayPal (`/api/account/paypal`), which also records the PayPal account their sales are paid into.

responses.name: Response_200
responses.status: Signed in. The `ot_session` cookie is set.

responseCode.detail: Signed in. The `ot_session` cookie is set.

headers.name: Set-Cookie
headers.description: The session cookie: `ot_session=<token>`, HttpOnly, for a year.

requests.name: signOut
requests.description: Ends this browser's session and clears the `ot_session` cookie.

requests.name: createShop

data.description: `source=photo`: the product photo, up to 8 MB.
`source=photo`: a sentence or two about the product. Required if there is no photo.
`source=link`: a product page, or your own app or game page.
The link name you want. If omitted, the AI suggests one.
Where buyers use an access code.
USD. If omitted, the AI suggests a price.

requests.description:
Starts a draft shop from one of three sources. Gemini designs the page and guesses the
setup; check it with `getShop`, adjust with `updateShop`, then go live.

Sent with a session cookie from `signIn`, the shop belongs to that account, which also
becomes its seller email (and PayPal email, after Log in with PayPal) unless you give one.

- `source=photo`: a `photo` and/or a `description` of your own product.
- `source=link`: a `url`. If Channel3 recognises it as a store's product page, the shop
  becomes a recommendation (`product_type: referral`); otherwise the page is read and you
  sell the product yourself with PayPal.
- `source=channel3`: a `productId` from `searchProducts` (a recommendation).

Takes 15–40 seconds. Hero art, if available, is generated afterwards (`hero_status`).

requests.name: getShop
requests.description: Everything about the shop, including the AI's design spec and guesses.

pathVariableData.description: The shop's link name (current or former).

requests.name: updateShop
requests.description:
Changes only the fields you send. Renaming `slug` keeps the old link working (it
redirects). Set `status: live` to publish; a digital product needs its file (or, for
access codes, `access_url`) first.

pathVariableData.description: The shop's link name (current or former).

requests.name: refineShopDesign
requests.description: "Make it warmer", "shorter copy", "more premium". Gemini edits the design spec.

pathVariableData.description: The shop's link name (current or former).

requests.name: regenerateHeroArt
requests.description: Starts generation in the background. Poll `getShop` for `hero_status`.

pathVariableData.description: The shop's link name (current or former).

requests.name: uploadDigitalFile
requests.description: Uploads or replaces a digital product's file, up to 25 MB. Each paid order gets a download link for it.

pathVariableData.description: The shop's link name (current or former).

requests.name: addPhotos

data.description: An image, up to 15 MB. The endpoint also accepts the field repeated, to add several in one request.

requests.description: Adds one or more photos after the cover. Each is turned upright, resized to at most 2000 px and stored as WebP. A shop holds up to 8 photos; buyers swipe through them on the shop page. Not for recommendations, which show the retailer's photos.

pathVariableData.description: The shop's link name (current or former).

requests.name: setPhotoOrder
requests.description: Sets the photo order; the first becomes the cover. Leaving a photo out removes it.

pathVariableData.description: The shop's link name (current or former).

requests.name: checkLinkName
requests.description: Normalises a proposed link name and says whether a new shop can use it.

responses.name: Response_200
responses.status: The normalised name and whether it can be used.

responseCode.detail: The normalised name and whether it can be used.

queryParams.description: Anything; it is normalised (`Raptor Rush` becomes `raptor-rush`).

requests.name: searchProducts
requests.description: Searches 100M+ products from 25k+ stores through Channel3. Pass a result's `id` to `createShop` with `source=channel3`.

queryParams.description: What to look for, in plain words.

requests.name: getPayPalClientToken
requests.description:
A browser-safe client token for the PayPal JavaScript SDK v6
(`paypal.createInstance({ clientToken })`), bound to the requesting site's domain.
Shop pages call this before showing the PayPal button.

responses.name: Response_200
responses.status: A token for this site's domain.

responseCode.detail: A token for this site's domain.

requests.name: createCheckoutOrder
requests.description:
Creates the PayPal order for one unit of a live shop's product. The amount always comes
from the shop, never from the caller. Pass the returned `id` to the PayPal JS SDK.

requests.name: captureCheckoutOrder
requests.description:
Call after the buyer approves. Records the sale; digital orders get a download link or access code.
Safe to call repeatedly: before approval it answers 409, so a page can poll it while the PayPal window is open.

pathVariableData.description: The PayPal order id that `createCheckoutOrder` returned.

requests.name: verifyAccessCode
requests.description:
For apps and games sold with access codes. Callable from any origin (CORS `*`): it only
answers valid or not for one shop, and counts uses. Accepts the shop's current or former
link names, and codes typed loosely (lower case, spaces, no dashes).

responses.name: Response_200
responses.status: The answer. Invalid codes are also a 200.

responseCode.detail: The answer. Invalid codes are also a 200.

requests.name: listOrders
requests.description: Newest first. Checkouts that were never approved are left out.

pathVariableData.description: The shop's link name (current or former).

requests.name: markOrderShipped
requests.description: Saves the tracking number and pushes it to PayPal, so the buyer sees it in PayPal.

pathVariableData.description: The shop's link name (current or former).

requests.name: listWebhookEvents
requests.description: The last 50 PayPal webhook deliveries about this shop's orders, with signature results.

pathVariableData.description: The shop's link name (current or former).

requests.name: downloadFile
requests.description: A paid digital order's private link. Works 5 times within 14 days.

pathVariableData.description: The download token from a paid order's thank-you page.

requests.name: getImage
requests.description: Public images only. Purchased files are never served here.
